archetypes.name: callsite-scanner
archetypes.rationale: The plan fixes exactly 3 sites in design/SKILL.md and 3 in implement/SKILL.md, but the cost-line-only prose pattern may recur in anti-halt rule cross-references, NEVER list entries, .claude/rules/ files, or shared skill docs not enumerated by the plan.
archetypes.prompt_body: Search all orchestrator-facing Markdown files (skills/*/SKILL.md, skills/*/references/*.md, skills/shared/*.md, .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md, .claude/rules/*.md, AGENTS.md) for every occurrence of the cost-line-only emission contract phrases such as 'single verbatim - **Cost**:', 'cost-line-only', 'single extracted', and 'emit that one line'. For each hit, check whether the plan explicitly targets that site for update or explicitly marks it out-of-scope. Flag any site the plan silently omits. Also verify no other anti-halt NEVER entries in either SKILL.md file reference the old cost-line pattern beyond the three enumerated sites. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: path-existence-verifier
archetypes.rationale: The plan's entire orchestrator-emit contract rests on the assumption that render-final-summary.sh writes to $DESIGN_TMPDIR/final-summary.md and write-final-report.sh writes to $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/summary-final.md, but if the actual scripts use different paths or conditional write logic the plan's Read/cat mechanism silently reads nothing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Read skills/design/scripts/render-final-summary.sh and skills/implement/scripts/write-final-report.sh and confirm the exact disk paths each script writes its canonical block to, under what conditions (success path, cancellation path, --post-publish-only vs --pre-publish-only), and whether the file is guaranteed non-empty before the script exits. Compare those observed paths against the plan's assumed paths ($DESIGN_TMPDIR/final-summary.md and $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/summary-final.md). Also check whether the --print-stdout branch in write-final-report.sh writes to disk at all or only to stdout, since the plan relies on disk presence for the orchestrator emit. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: test-pin-exactness
archetypes.rationale: The plan proposes replacing grep -Fq pins in test-render-cost-line-callsites.sh with new literal strings; if the planned SKILL.md prose differs even one character from the proposed grep pin, the test silently passes against an unedited SKILL.md and provides no regression protection.
archetypes.prompt_body: Read scripts/test-render-cost-line-callsites.sh and note every grep -Fq (or equivalent exact-match) pin string it asserts. Then verify whether the plan's proposed replacement pin strings — 'the orchestrator MUST read $DESIGN_TMPDIR/final-summary.md and emit its full body verbatim as plain chat markdown', 'the orchestrator MUST emit the full body of summary-final.md verbatim as plain chat markdown', and 'The only orchestrator-text addition permitted after the Bash summary is the verbatim full-body emission of $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/summary-final.md' — appear verbatim anywhere in the current SKILL.md files or would require the SKILL.md edits to land first before the test can pass. Check whether the test has a negative assertion that the old cost-line prose is absent; if not, flag the gap because a partial edit could leave both old and new prose and the test would not detect it. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
